name: Dyssegmental dysplasia, Rolland-Desbuquois type

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and radiological diagnostic criteria for Dyssegmental dysplasia, Rolland-Desbuquois type

criteria.description: Severe short-limbed dwarfism with characteristic skeletal abnormalities
Multiple vertebral segmentation anomalies including hemivertebrae and platyspondyly
Distinctive radiographic features including metaphyseal irregularities and delayed ossification
Identification of pathogenic variants in the gene(s) associated with DDSRD if available
Presence of characteristic facial dysmorphism and respiratory complications

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of severe short-limbed dwarfism with vertebral segmentation defects and characteristic radiological pattern
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic confirmation is supportive but not mandatory for diagnosis due to rarity and limited molecular data.

searchTerms: severe short arm and leg bones
extreme short stature with short limbs
dwarfism with short arms and legs
several spine bones with segmentation defects
irregular bone growth near ends of long bones
unusual facial features with midface underdevelopment
facial shape abnormalities including flat midface

common.symptomName: Respiratory distress due to thoracic cage abnormalities
searchTerms: breathing difficulty from chest cage problems
respiratory distress due to thorax abnormalities
lung issues from chest wall defects

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests; no specific biochemical markers identified
imaging: Radiographs showing severe platyspondyly, metaphyseal irregularities, and vertebral segmentation defects
Delayed ossification centers on skeletal survey
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes implicated in skeletal development (specific gene not definitively established)
other: Clinical observation of characteristic facial and skeletal phenotype

distinguishingFeatures: Distinctive radiographic features with absent ossification of vertebral bodies
Later onset and milder clinical course

redFlags: Severe respiratory distress in neonatal period
Failure to thrive with feeding difficulties
references: Rolland-Desbuquois C, et al. Dyssegmental dysplasia: a new lethal skeletal dysplasia. Am J Med Genet. 1989.
